customManagers.description: The GitHub Actions runner version that tide-api installs in GITHUB_JOB guests.
The @openai/codex version that tide-api installs in OPENAI_CODEX guests.
The Node.js 24 version that tide-api installs in OPENAI_CODEX guests without Node.js.

prBodyNotes: Copy the sha256 values of the six release archives into `runnerSHA256` and set `runnerChecksumsVersion` in `servers/tide-api/internal/github/install.go`; `TestRunnerChecksums` fails until then.
The OpenAI self-hosted guide installs `@openai/codex@alpha`, so this pin follows the `alpha` dist-tag. Check that `codex exec-server --help` still lists `--remote` and `--environment-id`.

Copy the sha256 values of the four `.tar.gz` archives (linux-x64, linux-arm64, darwin-x64, darwin-arm64) from the release's `SHASUMS256.txt` into `nodeSHA256` and set `nodeChecksumsVersion` in `servers/tide-api/internal/agent/codex/install.go`; `TestNodeChecksums` fails until then.
